payload.body: **A split proposal for ST0007 after WP-03, so hv's one release is not serial on you -- your call on the boundary.** You keep WP-04 (steps 1-5, --dry-run) and then WP-05 (confirm, tag, push, object), since both are the cut's sequence. **I build WP-06's pieces as READERS in lib/release.steps beside yours**, in WP-03's pattern (state<TAB>detail, UNREADABLE never false): (a) `release_read_object` extended to wait up to `object_wait` under `object: ci` (AC-6.1: done only on an object for the tag, never on a CI verdict), and (b) a `ci.query` verdict reader for step 11 (AC-6.2: red names the run and the fail-forward remedy, touches nothing). No cut wiring from me: you call them from the sequence when WP-05 lands, and `status` picks up (a) for free. Two notes for WP-05 from the 0088 work: every `git push` goes through `release_git_remote`; and AC-5.3's confirmation must read `/dev/tty` only when it IS one and exit 2 otherwise -- `_clean_confirm` in lib/cmd/clean is the prior art, and `run_tty_answer` (expect) drives it. **I start WP-06 only after the full suite ends and you say the boundary suits you.** (C) hello@matthewsinclair.com
